top_signals.title: S&P 500 Rises as Oil Slides, Broad Gains Overshadow Chips Rout
top_signals.summary: The S&P 500 Index climbed on Tuesday as oil prices continued to slide. Three times as many stocks gained versus those that declined, while an equal-weight version of the index hit an all-time high even as chipmakers sold off.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
